rules.allowed_only: Every MCP read must pass the current server whitelist.
rules.source_of_truth: MCP tools read the REMOTE SQLite database populated by the running Telegram collector.
rules.freshness: Do not claim real-time freshness from a historical GitHub snapshot. Use the current REMOTE database and report uncertainty if collector health is not verified.
rules.mode_selection: The user should not need to choose a technical retrieval mode.
rules.legacy: Yandex Serverless rolling/on-demand GitHub workflows are retired and are not the current production path.
